name: Data Analyzer: Text escaping removes all active formatting from hostile text but shows it unchanged
objective: Proves untrusted text (e.g. from an uploaded dictionary) cannot produce images, links, HTML, maths or formatting on the page.

steps.data: 5 texts: an image link to a made-up address, a javascript: link, an tag, a bare web address, and a mix of maths, emoji code, bold, code and heading marks
steps.expected: After removing the escape backslashes, the text equals the original; each of the characters ! ( ) [ ] < > * ` # $ : in the result is preceded by a backslash

name: Data Analyzer: Text escaping copes with non-text values
objective: Proves the escaping helper does not crash on nothing or numbers.

name: Data Analyzer: Field description shown on the page escapes every dictionary-supplied string
objective: Proves a hostile dictionary entry cannot inject images or links into the field display.

steps.action: Build the detailed display text for a field whose name, type, description, min, max and allowed values contain image and link syntax
steps.expected: No unescaped '![' and no unescaped '](http' remain, and the genuine '*[Required]*' label is still present

name: Data Analyzer: Field display does not crash on unusual dictionary entries
objective: Proves odd dictionary entries (empty, a number as the name, wrong-typed description or allowed values) produce text that starts with a readable name and type: '(unnamed)' and 'unknown' when missing, the number itself when given. Runs over 4 entries, in short and detailed form.

steps.action: Build the short and detailed display text for each odd entry
steps.data: 4 entries: empty; field_name 5; description 7 with allowed_values 'abc'; min None, max 3, description a list
steps.expected: Both calls return text each time, with no error. The content is not checked

name: Data Analyzer: Wrongly shaped JSON dictionaries are rejected with a clear error
objective: Proves a JSON dictionary that is not the expected structure is refused.

steps.data: 7 inputs: empty list, plain text, number 5, rules as a list, fields as an object, fields containing text, fields containing numbers
steps.expected: A ValueError is raised each time

name: Data Analyzer: A correctly shaped JSON dictionary is accepted
objective: Proves valid dictionaries pass through unchanged.

steps.action: Validate a dictionary with rules for 'age' and one field named 'age'
steps.expected: The very same dictionary is returned

name: Data Analyzer: Page code builds no script elements or raw-HTML components
objective: Proves by text search that the old browser-console helper and embedded scripts are gone.
precondition: web_app.py is read as text, not run.

steps.action: Search the source for 'log_to_browser_console', '<script' (any case) and 'components.html'

name: Data Analyzer: Page code has no print statements
objective: Proves nothing is printed to the container log by direct print calls, where file names could leak.

steps.action: Parse web_app.py and list every call to print

name: Data Analyzer: Log fingerprint of an uploaded file hides its name
objective: Proves the identifier used in logs shows only extension, size and a short hash.

steps.action: Make a fingerprint for the made-up name 'SITE-017_participants.csv' with size 1234
steps.expected: The text contains neither 'SITE-017' nor 'participants'; it contains 'ext=csv', 'size=1234' and 'name_sha256=' followed by 8 hexadecimal characters

name: Data Analyzer: Log fingerprint is repeatable and differs between names
objective: Proves the same file gives the same fingerprint and different files give different ones.

steps.action: Fingerprint 'a.csv' twice and 'b.csv' once, all with size 1
steps.expected: The two for 'a.csv' are equal and differ from the one for 'b.csv'

name: Data Analyzer: Failed-analysis log line records only the error type, not the error text
objective: Intended to prove error messages from the service (which could contain sensitive text) are not written to logs. It checks the page source text only.
precondition: web_app.py is read and parsed as text; no analysis is actually run and the captured log is not examined.

steps.action: Check the source for the old log-format string with the error text, then check each logger call that mentions 'analysis_failed'
steps.expected: The old string is absent and no such logger call includes 'str(e)'. If no logger call mentions 'analysis_failed' the second check passes with nothing checked

name: Data Analyzer: Error and warning messages that embed values escape them
objective: Intended to prove on-screen error text built from upload data goes through the escaping helper. It checks the page source text only.
precondition: web_app.py is read as text; nothing is run.

steps.action: Find every single-line st.error/st.warning f-string in the source and inspect embedded expressions involving e, issue, rec, dict_file or uploaded_file
steps.expected: Each such expression uses the escape helper, shows only the error class name, or involves a size (the word 'size' anywhere in the expression is accepted). Messages split across lines are not examined
